message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Understanding database sharding can be challenging for developers trying to scale systems efficiently, and your video on database sharding caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, connecting with teachers, academic leaders and school decision makers. We are exploring an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, giving you a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
